content.title: Police Intensify Investigation into Sexual Harassment Case Against TVK Functionary
content.caption: The Coimbatore District Police have intensified their investigation into allegations of sexual harassment against Karamadai union secretary Karupusamy, a prominent TVK functionary.

slides.heading: Police Intensify Investigation into Sexual Harassment Case Against TVK Functionary
slides.text: The Coimbatore District Police have intensified their investigation into allegations of sexual harassment against Karamadai union secretary Karupusamy, a prominent TVK functionary.

slides.heading: Allegations Against Karupusamy
slides.text: The complainant alleges that Karupusamy sexually harassed her in May this year, leading to her removal from her post.

slides.heading: Accused in the Case
slides.text: The accused in the case include Karamadai union secretary Karupusamy, party worker Sabitha, and her husband Pandi.
